name: @lifeos/ai-providers
description: The AI Provider Interface (architecture-decisions.md Batch 1 Decision 5): a model-agnostic abstraction over external LLM providers. OpenAI is the only wired provider in Milestone 1; the task-size routing hook (lightweight/reasoning/large-context) and fallback-provider mechanism exist now so adding Anthropic/Google/local providers later requires no change to any caller. Also enforces Data Classification before every external AI request (Round 3 Decision 8) — this is the one gate every caller goes through, so no business logic ever talks to a vendor SDK directly.
